research_questions: Are the frozen 10 percent task loss and 20 percent ACK loss assumptions representative of real UAV wireless sessions?
Are real link failures independent per scene or temporally bursty?
Do public flight logs contain valid observable evidence for a 2 percent per-scene receiver runtime-context reset hazard?
Does fixed-10 heartbeat remain on the best total-bit versus clean-rate frontier under an empirically calibrated fault model?

aadm.split_population: USRP/Testbed 33 flights Sep and matching LoRa flight directories
aadm.split_algorithm: sort ascending by SHA256('stage8-aadm-v1|' + normalized_flight_id); first 13 development, remaining 20 confirmation
aadm.other_flights_policy: digital-twin and 12 preparation flights may be used only for exploratory parser development and are never counted as real-flight confirmation

alfa.split_algorithm: map every processed sequence to its underlying raw-flight timestamp; sort raw-flight IDs ascending by SHA256('stage8-alfa-v1|' + normalized_raw_flight_id); first 19 development, remaining 20 confirmation
alfa.raw_log_policy: all processed sequences, telemetry and dataflash files derived from one raw flight inherit the same split; only development raw-flight groups may be opened before detector freeze

access_governance.reason_not_algorithm_final: AADM calibrates wireless faults and ALFA contains flight-system faults; neither is an independent wideband spectrum block-selection Final.

fault_model_decision.if_reset_not_observable: retain 2 percent only as a conservative stress point and do not call it empirically calibrated

protocol_replay.if_no_interval_passes: retain fixed10 as the frozen stress-model boundary
protocol_replay.if_interval_passes_confirmation: create a new Stage-8 candidate; do not rewrite Stage-7

claim_boundaries: Downloading, hashing, extracting nested archives, and listing member names do not consume confirmation values.
AADM link measurements cannot directly identify receiver process or codebook-context resets.
ALFA engine and actuator faults are not equivalent to semantic receiver-context resets.
No public-data result may be called target-board evidence.
Stage-6 Final remains FAILED and Stage-7 remains without an independent external Final.
